items.title: Lee Paige Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: I think that I did quite a few Ethel Waters' numbers. I did one that she recorded and it's very popular and I did it quite frequently.

ctx.x: Right in the sheet music. Well, what she's using is in the sheet music too. Bill.

Yes. Yeah, I know Ethel Waters and, you know, Ethel Waters has been around quite a long time. She used to do some coon shouting too, you know. Back in 1918, when she recorded the song in 1918, there'll be some changes made on Black Bird Recording Company. In 1918, she was doing coon shouting for this Black Bird Recording Company. What was that?
